problems.affinity: Densest k-subgraph concerns his approximation-algorithm research.
problems.affinity_type: editorial inference, not an attributed priority
problems.status_note: Checked through 10 September 2026. The constant-factor algorithm is already ruled out assuming ETH, which remains unproved. The May 2026 primary source explicitly notes the absence of NP-hardness of approximation even at factor 1.001. This card asks about a deterministic constant-factor algorithm on all unweighted graphs, and preserves the distinction between conditional evidence and an unconditional resolution.
